name: The Shattered Kingdoms
description: A realm fractured by an ancient war. Noble houses vie for power while darker forces stir in the shadows.
seed_prompt: A classic fantasy realm of magic and monsters, where heroes rise to face ancient evils.
lore_content:
The Shattered Kingdoms were once a unified empire under the Dragon Throne. Three centuries ago, the War of Sundering broke the land into seven rival kingdoms when the last Emperor fell to the Shadowbane Conspiracy.

King Aldric Ironhold rules Valdheim, the northern kingdom of dwarves and men. His iron mines fuel the realm's forges, and his stubborn honor makes him both respected and inflexible. He lost his wife to a dragon raid twenty winters past and has sworn vengeance upon all wyrm-kind.

Queen Seraphina Starweave governs the Elven realm of Sylvaneth from her crystal palace. Ancient beyond human reckoning, she remembers the world before the Sundering. Her patience is legendary, but some whisper she has grown too detached from mortal concerns.

The Archmage Thandril maintains the Floating Citadel of Nethys, training the next generation of wizards. His tower drifts between kingdoms, bound by treaty to remain neutral. He guards the Prismatic Codex, last artifact of the old empire.

Beneath the mountains, the Underdark stirs. The Lich-Queen Malevora builds her army of the dead, seeking the Crown of Souls that would let her raise an unstoppable host. Her phylactery is hidden somewhere in the mortal realms.

The Order of the Silver Dawn sends paladins across the kingdoms, hunting evil wherever it festers. Sir Gareth the Resolute leads their chapter, though he secretly doubts his faith after witnessing atrocities in the border wars.

In the port city of Saltmere, the Thieves' Guild controls trade routes and information alike. Their guildmaster, the Fox, has never been seen without their porcelain mask. They say the Fox knows every secret in the kingdoms.

The Wandering Sage Morwen travels the roads, offering wisdom to those who show kindness to strangers. Some believe she is a goddess in mortal guise; others say she is simply mad. Her prophecies, however, have an unsettling tendency to come true.
